name: FileUpload
purpose: A file-selection and upload list with validation, progress, cancellation, and retry.
description: Choose local files with type, size, count, and duplicate validation. No network request is made unless the application supplies onUpload. The adapter receives an AbortSignal and progress callback; cancellation and retry remain available. Files stay ready on the device in selection-only mode.

props.name: accept
props.description: Native file accept syntax: extensions, MIME types, or type wildcards.

props.name: onUpload
props.description: Supply your transport. Without one, accepted files remain ready on this device.

guidance.overview: A file-selection and upload list with validation, progress, cancellation, and retry.
usage: Configure accept, maxSizeBytes, and maxFiles for the actual endpoint. Selection validates file type, size, duplicates, and count.
Without onUpload, files are selected locally and remain ready. Provide onUpload to perform transfer and honor its AbortSignal.
Report real progress through onProgress. Removing a file or unmounting aborts its pending transfer.
accessibility: A native file input and a keyboard-operable choose button provide an alternative to drag and drop.
Upload status and progress are announced; failed uploads can be retried, and removal returns focus to the choose control.
context: Use for attachments and imports. The host still owns server validation, storage, and completion policy.
